apply_requirements: explicit maintenance authorization and artifact hash approval
fresh Firebase Admin account read in the pinned project matches auth_record
reviewed database backup and restore evidence
separately approved maintenance identity; never runtime connector or Hosting identity

request.query:
mutation PrepareFirstScopeHierarchy(
  $organizationId: UUID!, $organizationName: String!, $uid: String!, $canViewSensitive: Boolean!,
  $collectionId: UUID!,
  $c0Id: UUID!, $c0Name: String!,
  $c1Id: UUID!, $c1Name: String!,
  $c2Id: UUID!, $c2Name: String!,
  $c3Id: UUID!, $c3Name: String!,
  $c4Id: UUID!, $c4Name: String!,
  $c5Id: UUID!, $c5Name: String!,
  $c6Id: UUID!, $c6Name: String!,
  $c7Id: UUID!, $c7Name: String!,
  $c8Id: UUID!, $c8Name: String!,
  $c9Id: UUID!, $c9Name: String!,
  $c10Id: UUID!, $c10Name: String!,
  $c11Id: UUID!, $c11Name: String!,
  $c12Id: UUID!, $c12Name: String!,
  $c13Id: UUID!, $c13Name: String!,
  $c14Id: UUID!, $c14Name: String!,
  $c15Id: UUID!, $c15Name: String!,
  $c16Id: UUID!, $c16Name: String!,
  $c17Id: UUID!, $c17Name: String!
) @transaction {
  organization_insert(data: {id: $organizationId, name: $organizationName})
  query @redact {
    matchingCollections: collections(where: {id: {in: [$c0Id, $c1Id, $c2Id, $c3Id, $c4Id, $c5Id, $c6Id, $c7Id, $c8Id, $c9Id, $c10Id, $c11Id, $c12Id, $c13Id, $c14Id, $c15Id, $c16Id, $c17Id]}}, limit: 1)
      @check(expr: "this.size() == 0", message: "Collection identifier already exists") { id }
  }
  c0: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c0Id,
    name: $c0Name, parentId: null})
  c1: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c1Id,
    name: $c1Name, parentId: $c0Id})
  c2: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c2Id,
    name: $c2Name, parentId: $c0Id})
  c3: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c3Id,
    name: $c3Name, parentId: $c0Id})
  c4: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c4Id,
    name: $c4Name, parentId: $c0Id})
  c5: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c5Id,
    name: $c5Name, parentId: $c0Id})
  c6: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c6Id,
    name: $c6Name, parentId: $c0Id})
  c7: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c7Id,
    name: $c7Name, parentId: null})
  c8: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c8Id,
    name: $c8Name, parentId: $c7Id})
  c9: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c9Id,
    name: $c9Name, parentId: $c7Id})
  c10: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c10Id,
    name: $c10Name, parentId: $c7Id})
  c11: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c11Id,
    name: $c11Name, parentId: $c7Id})
  c12: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c12Id,
    name: $c12Name, parentId: $c7Id})
  c13: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c13Id,
    name: $c13Name, parentId: null})
  c14: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c14Id,
    name: $c14Name, parentId: null})
  c15: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c15Id,
    name: $c15Name, parentId: $c14Id})
  c16: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c16Id,
    name: $c16Name, parentId: $c14Id})
  c17: collection_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, id: $c17Id,
    name: $c17Name, parentId: $c14Id})
  organizationMember_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, uid: $uid, active: true})
  collectionMember_insert(data: {organizationId: $organizationId, collectionId: $collectionId,
    uid: $uid, active: true, role: "admin", canViewSensitive: $canViewSensitive})
}
